query: When do I have to hand my laptop back after I leave?

reset or wipe the device; IT does this.

[3] [APPLIES TO YOU]

must be returned under the IT Asset Return Policy, which explains the return
options for employees who do not visit an office.

- [ ] Remove personal files from your laptop. Do not copy company data to
      personal devices.
- [ ] Update your personal email address in the HR system so that we can send
      your documents.

[5] [APPLIES TO YOU]

Question: When do I have to hand my laptop back after I leave?

Answer (cite every claim as [chunk number]):

response: According to [3], equipment must be returned under the IT Asset Return Policy when you leave the company.
